subject: stf
title: STF.------POL.DY.
description: Second diagram on page 430, paired with (R)SG × TR above: (C)STF (the concept of source transfer) crossed with POL-DY (political dynamics — the working political reality of that activism). (C)STF sits at the center with the subject-arrow, and its main line runs up-left to the partner, drawn as POL-DYM. Two lines leave the main line. One runs right to TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with INT (intention) rising from it and AF-NT (affinity nature) branching from it down-right; CN-INFO (controlled information) and SOC-RT-P (social-reality-particular) branch from AF-NT's line, and ALT-F (alternative functionalism) branches in turn from SOC-RT-P. The other drops as a vertical to MT-INFO (multi-information) at the bottom-left, with TRS (transition) running right from it and ALT-D (alternative definitions) rising from TRS's line.
